source_text.body:
Order groceries from Walmart via a shopping agent
The author tried an agent to browse, add to cart and check out at Walmart; it took over 16 minutes and ultimately failed.
·
Nov 27, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
Mia Sato, after receiving many pitches about agentic commerce for Black Friday and Cyber Monday, tried ordering from Walmart through an agent. The agent was meant to browse, add items to the cart, confirm details and go through checkout. The post doesn't name the agent or say what was ordered.
How it went
The run took more than 16 minutes and still failed. The post doesn't say at which step it broke.
Worth knowing
Expect a slow run: 16+ minutes for one Walmart order that still failed, so don't count on agent checkout for time-sensitive shopping.
Try it yourself
with
Operator
Copy prompt
Go to [Walmart.com or my grocery store's site] while I'm logged in and add these items to my cart: [list of items with quantities and any brand or size preferences]. If an item is unavailable, suggest a close substitute instead of picking one yourself. Stop when the cart is complete and show me the items, prices, and total. Pause before checkout or payment and wait for my approval.
Original source: https://bsky.app/profile/miasato.bsky.social/post/3n3ay2g5p6k2a
